query: What company traits explain regional clustering?

per_column.name: primary_sector
per_column.rationale: Interpretable, well-separated industry categories that can be segmented and cross-tabulated against regional clusters; a classic company trait for explaining regional specialization.

per_column.name: enterprise_vs_consumer_focus
per_column.rationale: Clean, low-cardinality B2B/B2C/hybrid split that is easy to group on and compare across regions; an external associational trait.

per_column.name: company_stage_signal
per_column.rationale: Well-labeled maturity categories (established, growth, venture-backed, etc.) that support meaningful regional comparison; interpretable ordinal-ish segmentation.

per_column.name: profitability_or_funding_model
per_column.rationale: Interpretable funding-model categories, though it substantially overlaps with company_stage_signal (venture-backed vs bootstrapped), somewhat reducing marginal informativeness.

per_column.name: service_delivery_model
per_column.rationale: Distinct, interpretable delivery-model buckets; adds a business-model dimension, though it partially correlates with primary_sector and enterprise focus.

per_column.name: cloud_native_architecture
per_column.rationale: Clean binary trait that is interpretable and segmentable, but is a narrower/derivative signal that overlaps with service_delivery_model's cloud_saas category.

judge.rationale: All six columns are external, interpretable company traits with well-separated categories that can be grouped and cross-tabulated against regional_cluster, satisfying the EDA claim of opening informative, human-understandable relationships around the focus. None merely restate the geographic focus. The main weakness is redundancy: company_stage_signal and profitability_or_funding_model largely encode the same venture-backed-vs-established axis, and cloud_native_architecture overlaps with service_delivery_model's cloud_saas bucket, so as a set they cover fewer independent dimensions (sector, business orientation, maturity/funding, delivery model) than the count of columns suggests. Still, the set strongly supports discovering interpretable trait-to-region relationships.
